title: Your summit team
text: LeighAnn Scott is your event contact. Before you leave, email leighann.scott@tdsynnex.com. On your way or at the resort, call (480) 628-4002. Ask her about your hotel confirmation, your airport ride, food allergies or changes.

title: Check in on Saturday
text: Stop by the event check-in desk at the Welcome Reception on Saturday, October 24, between 7:00 and 9:00 PM. You will get your name badge and registration materials.

title: What’s included
text: Your attendance includes round-trip airfare, a 3-night stay at The Ritz-Carlton O’ahu, Turtle Bay, airport transportation, scheduled meals and activities, and one guest. Your participation is required at all scheduled event activities. Missing any of them may mean charges back to your company, including hotel fees.

title: Guests
text: Guests are not included in the meeting portion of the event: breakfast, the business meetings and lunch on October 25 and 26. Each guest has a food and beverage credit of $100 a day for breakfast and lunch on October 25 and 26. Order at any of the resort’s restaurants and charge it to your room. Alcohol is not included.

title: What to wear
text: Meetings: business casual, and jeans are fine. Dinners and receptions: resort casual. Our dinners are outdoors. Sunday at Secret Beach: bathing suits, cover-ups, sandals, sunscreen, hats, sunglasses and beach attire. Changing rooms are available whenever you want to change. UTV Raptor: closed-toe shoes and clothes that can get a little dirty. A valid driver’s license is required. Jurassic Park movie tour: comfortable clothing and shoes, plus a rain jacket or poncho in case of rain. Spa massage: a bathing suit and flip-flops.

title: Getting here and home
text: Follow the itinerary from WorldTravel Inc. Your tickets are electronic, and printing your e-ticket is a good idea. Check that your name, the dates and the times are right, and that your name matches your ID or passport exactly. If something is wrong, call WorldTravel right away at +1 (855) 864-8728 in the US or +1 (484) 948-2618 outside the US. Baggage fees are at your own expense, and weight limits vary by airline. We provide transportation between Honolulu International Airport (HNL) and the Ritz-Carlton. Look for the email titled Transportation Confirmation. If you extend your stay somewhere other than the Ritz-Carlton, that transportation is on your own. Ama Transportation Services at 808-583-3495 is recommended, booked at least 72 hours ahead. Saturday, October 24 is arrivals and Tuesday, October 27 is departures.

title: Your hotel room
text: The Ritz-Carlton O’ahu, Turtle Bay. Check-in is at 3:00 PM and check-out is at 11:00 AM. If you asked for a room when you registered, your confirmation number comes in a separate email from LeighAnn Scott. Questions or changes go to her.

title: Your one-on-one meetings
text: Please refer to your individual calendar invite for your time and additional information. Saturday: 10:00 AM to 5:30 PM. Sunday and Monday: as scheduled, plus one-on-one time at lunch in Kuilima 3. Meetings are held in the Maui Room and Moloka’i Room.

title: Sunday: Secret Beach and Dragon Lawn
text: 1:15 PM: meet in the Hotel Lobby for transportation. 1:30 PM: depart for Secret Beach at Kualoa Ranch. Activities include kayaking, paddleboarding, lawn games and beach volleyball. 5:00 PM: board the boats for a 10-minute light cruise to Dragon Lawn. 5:15 to 7:00 PM: dinner reception at Dragon Lawn. 7:00 PM: transportation back to the hotel. Bring a swimsuit, water shoes, a towel, reef-safe mineral sunscreen and sunglasses. Showers and changing rooms are on site, so pack dry clothes for dinner.

title: Monday afternoon
text: Excursion choices include the UTV Raptor adventure, the Jurassic Park movie tour and spa massages from 1:00 to 5:00 PM. Please refer to your individual excursion card for timing, location and shuttle details. Spa appointment times are confirmed at the check-in desk at Saturday’s Welcome Reception.

title: Food allergies
text: If you have any food allergies, email LeighAnn Scott before the event at leighann.scott@tdsynnex.com.

title: If you need to cancel
text: Email LeighAnn Scott as soon as possible at leighann.scott@tdsynnex.com.
